agent_explanation: Body moves horizontally at ~45 m/s toward a thin horizontal wall (h=0.28). With dt~0.003 and 5 substeps, the per-substep horizontal displacement ~0.027 is small but vertical position descends from just above the wall (step 15 distance +0.236) to overlapping. Once overlapping, distance goes -0.04 at step 17 then -0.178 at step 18 exceeding 0.15 limit. Collision impulse/positional correction fails to prevent growing penetration while body slides fast along the top face; likely the contact normal resolution does not account for high tangential velocity grazing the thin slab, allowing accumulation of penetration.
